name: Assistant
needs: read:entities — every combatant's sheet, so it can see who is hurt, how fast they are and what they are holding
read:board — where everyone is standing, and how far apart
read:records — the system's own spatial law: what a range band means in the world, how a step is paid for, and the whole menu of things a turn can be spent on
read:log — what already happened this fight, so a condition has a cause instead of an invented one
network: the model endpoint in its config
